text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraph breaks with transition words","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups ideas into separate sections and uses basic transitions to guide the reader."},{"evidence":"\"my talent is roaring like a lion\" / \"My other talent is hoola-hooping\" / \"My final talent is drawing\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay gives several distinct examples and some explanation for each one instead of staying at a single vague point."},{"evidence":"\"I enjoy drawing because i can draw what i'm feeling\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay sometimes explains an idea with a reason or personal detail rather than only naming it."},{"evidence":"\"my favorite skill is swimming fast because I can possibly beat anyone's scores\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The writing shows a bit more control over sentence structure and word order, even though errors remain."},{"evidence":"\"roaring like a lion\" / \"swimming fast\" / \"running fast\"","quality":"word choice","description":"The essay uses more specific vocabulary and concrete action words to describe abilities."}]}
